Notes.Text:
This update for libXfont2 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-44950: fs_read_glyphs() heap buffer overflow via cumulative glyph data overflow (bsc#1272661).
- CVE-2026-59679: fs_read_glyphs() heap OOB read/write via encoding array index mismatch (bsc#1272660).
